description: Read a conversation as plain text, with tool calls, file edits, and every panel out of sight. Your prompts appear as quiet quotes and the agent's replies in one narrow column, refreshed every two seconds while the agent works. A small dot shows when the agent is running, and older history loads on request. Open it from the thread header or command palette, assign a shortcut in BB's Keyboard settings, and press Escape to return to your unchanged layout and draft.
